title: Physically remove source-files from app workspace
decision: SG-0007 should physically remove workspaces/epp-full/source-files from the Archivist app workspace during import refresh. The original EPP repo and manual-development source process are not affected, and workspaces/epp-full/sources/regulatory remains retained.
context: After clarifying that source-files is development-only material, the remaining ambiguity was whether the Archivist app workspace should keep the folder but stop advertising it, or remove it entirely. The user approved physical removal from the app workspace.
rationale: Physical removal better matches the retention boundary and reduces the chance that future service, metadata, browsing, or download work accidentally exposes development-only source material.
alternatives_considered: Keep source-files in the app workspace but omit it from workspace metadata
Keep source-files and rely on the UI to hide it
Remove both source-files and retained regulatory sources
consequences: SG-0007 validation must confirm workspaces/epp-full/source-files is absent after refresh
Workspace metadata should remove source-file path and copied/missing source-file counts
The original EPP repo remains the place for development-only source material
Regulatory sources under workspaces/epp-full/sources/regulatory remain retained app inputs
